sections.title: Sound of the letter Vau
paragraphs: The letter is named (Vau) /faʊ/. Its main sound is heard in the word (Vater) /ˈfaːtɐ/, which means father. This letter has two sounds in German.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your upper teeth with your lower lip. Push the air through the small gap between them. For the first sound, keep your voice off so your throat stays still. For the second sound, turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In native German words and at the end of a word, it sounds voiceless, like in (Vogel) /ˈfoːɡl̩/. In borrowed words from other languages, it sounds voiced, like in (Vase) /ˈvaːzə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not always say this letter with a buzzing voice like in the English word vine. In many words it must sound voiceless, exactly like the first sound in fine.
